snippet.title: Brutal John 2 Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
EARLY ACCESS OUT NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859620/

Brutal John 2 is a ultraviolent old-school FPS set in a world overrun by mining rigs technologies, where it’s up to you to destroy them and reclaim control. Prepare for an adrenaline ride that pays homage to the best shooters of the '90s.
